race.comment: TRICKSTER (11) missed narrowly fresh before being slowly away and disappointing last time  out when in much stronger company at Belmont. Pike hops back on board today as he drops back to maiden company. Will need a touch of luck from the wide draw, but the debut run suggests he's good enough. PHAT CHAPS (2) is building into the campaign nicely, missing by 0.6L at Belmont in a Class 1. Back to maiden company now and remaining at a similar trip is a big tick. Should get every chance from the draw and rates highly on her latest performance. FLAVOURSOME (8) was just fair last time out over 2200m and comes back in trip today where she was in good order prior. Likely to get back in the run, but watch for her late in the race. FORTUNATE SPIRIT (6) missed by 1.8L at this track and steps out in trip for the first time today. Has good early speed and can put his best foot forward. OUI OUI LE VET (5) was impressive late and can be in the finish again out in trip.
